one_liner: Build apps, storefronts, and agents on Shopify's ecommerce platform using comprehensive APIs.
auth_notes: Shopify uses OAuth 2.0 flows, access tokens in request headers (e.g., X-Shopify-Access-Token), and client credentials.
access_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Shopify partner account and create apps and development stores at no cost.
api_notes: Covers GraphQL Admin API, REST Admin API, Storefront API, Partner API, and Customer Account API.
blocker_notes: Public docs and self-serve developer accounts allow building integrations immediately.

auth.quote: Most Shopify APIs, including the GraphQL Admin API, Storefront API, and Partner API, authenticate your app acting on behalf of a merchant or organization.

access.quote: To use the Shop APIs and SDKs, you need an app in the Dev Dashboard. This guide covers creating an app, configuring scopes, and retrieving your credentials.

api.quote: GraphQL Admin API reads and writes products, customers, orders, inventory, and the rest of the data behind the Shopify admin.

mcp.page_summary: Shopify developer documentation covers APIs, app creation, and tools like the Shopify CLI, but contains no mention of an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

verdict.quote: Whether you're just getting started, deep in the development process, or ready to distribute and monetize your work, Shopify's docs, dev tools and frameworks make building easy and efficient.
